purpose: Provide one canonical taxonomy for every page, report, card, document, source, entity, relationship, dashboard, download, newsletter item, product and internal operational surface before migration or tier enforcement.
objective: Move every important content item into the correct section and tier without breaking existing routes, evidence boundaries, search discovery or historical versions.
exitCondition: No important item is uncategorised, materially duplicated or inaccessible through navigation and search.
principles: Every important item receives one primary category, one primary subcategory and one canonical content type.
Items may carry secondary categories and topics, but they keep one canonical owner and route identity.
Truth status is independent from access tier; premium depth cannot upgrade speculation into fact.
Graph associations, scenarios and speculation remain preserved under explicit interpretive labels.
Corrections, contradictions, withdrawals, supersessions and public evidence boundaries remain publicly reachable wherever they qualify a public claim.
Existing URLs remain stable until redirect, navigation, search and related-content previews pass.
Duplicates are consolidated only after canonical ownership, inbound links, search references and historical value are known.
Internal and operational artifacts are classified, not automatically deleted.
Sensitive or victim-protection material receives a restricted classification rather than being forced into a normal paid tier.
Every migration decision remains report-only until the complete Phase 3 preview is approved.

claimPresentationClasses.research_hint: Speculative graph or association route; association is not proof.
claimPresentationClasses.scenario_analysis: Speculative scenario; not a factual forecast.
claimPresentationClasses.withdrawn: Withdrawn content retained for historical transparency.
claimPresentationClasses.superseded: Superseded content linked to its replacement.

routeConventions.redirectRule: Existing route remains canonical or receives a permanent redirect only after inbound links, search references and navigation are migrated.
routeConventions.slugRule: Stable lowercase ASCII slug; do not encode evidence status or tier into the canonical identity.

notAutomaticallyDuplicateWhen: same source cited by multiple investigations

internalItemsRequire: public replacement route when the item currently serves public navigation
